annotation.title_clean: Implementation and streamlining of EU internal market rules to strengthen the single market — European Parliament resolution of 11 September 2025 (2025/2009(INI))
annotation.title_en: Implementation and streamlining of EU internal market rules to strengthen the single market — European Parliament resolution of 11 September 2025 (2025/2009(INI))
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C/2026/1483
named_instruments_referenced: Internal Market Emergency and Resilience Act
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament non-legislative resolution calling for simplification, streamlining and better enforcement of EU single market rules to boost competitiveness, reduce burdens on SMEs, and clarify the interplay of digital laws (AI Act, GDPR, DSA, Product Liability Directive), with regulatory sandboxes and AI promoted as tools for administrative efficiency.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for competitiveness checks and high-quality impact assessments for all legislative proposals
Requests a fitness check clarifying overlaps among the DSA, GDPR, AI Act, Product Liability Directive and cybersecurity rules
Recommends regulatory sandboxes and iterative, co-regulatory approaches for emerging technologies such as AI
Urges a single IT tool for reporting product safety accidents and corrective measures
Stresses that simplification must not lower consumer protection standards
